name: whatif_kawhi

beats.head: WHAT IF HE STAYED?
beats.name: LEONARD
beats.vo: Kawhi Leonard won us a title, then left for the Clippers. What if he'd stayed?
beats.dlg: KAWHI LEFT FOR THE CLIPPERS.|WHAT IF HE'D STAYED?

beats.head: WITHOUT HIM
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Without him, we still went fifty-three and nineteen. That's on pace for sixty wins.

beats.head: GAME 7
beats.name: SIAKAM
beats.vo: And it took Boston seven games to knock us out in the second round.
beats.dlg: BOSTON NEEDED 7 GAMES|TO KNOCK US OUT.

beats.head: MEANWHILE
beats.name: LEONARD
beats.vo: Meanwhile, Kawhi's Clippers blew a three-one lead to Denver.
beats.dlg: KAWHI'S CLIPPERS BLEW|A 3-1 LEAD TO DENVER.

beats.head: THE WHAT IF
beats.name: LEONARD
beats.vo: Now put the Finals MVP back on a team that won fifty-three without him.
beats.dlg: PUT THE FINALS MVP BACK|ON A 53-WIN TEAM.

beats.head: BACK TO BACK?
beats.vo: Do we go back to back? Comment below.
beats.dlg: DO WE GO BACK TO BACK?|COMMENT BELOW!

caption:
WHAT IF KAWHI STAYED? 🎮🏀 He left in July 2019. We kept winning anyway.

• 2019: Kawhi, Finals MVP, our first title
• July 2019: he signs with the Clippers
• 2019-20 without him: 53-19, a 60-win pace in a 72-game season
• 2020 second round: Boston needs 7 games to beat us
• Same round: Kawhi's Clippers blow a 3-1 lead to Denver

Put him back on that team. Do we go back to back? 👇

facts.claim: Leonard: 2019 NBA champion and Finals MVP with Toronto, the Raptors' first title; signed with the Los Angeles Clippers as a free agent in July 2019
2019-20 Raptors went 53-19 in a 72-game season, a winning percentage equal to 60 wins in a full season; 53 wins
2020 playoffs: the Raptors lost to the Boston Celtics in seven (7) games in the Eastern Conference semifinals (second round), series 3-4
2020: the Clippers were eliminated by the Denver Nuggets in the Western Conference semifinals after surrendering a 3-1 series lead
Adding one (+1) player, Kawhi, to the 2020 team is the hypothetical
